dissent: The proposal's reachable fraction cannot answer the full question: pause-vs-duplicate/gap and duplicate-vs-gap edges are discriminated only by synthetic states, which a reviewer may reject as outside the original domain.
The six-pattern decision table assumes paused stays False and registration stays set through the core; that is inferred from the profile action list, not executed.

findings: All six attempt-guard sites encode the same four-step precedence chain and the same pair constructor: s_inclusive.py:26-30, s_split.py:29-31, s_audit.py:46-50, batch-06/guard_a.py:27-31, guard_b.py:26-28, guard_audit.py:27-31 — source inference by direct inspection, not executed enumeration.

Actual reachable attempt-decision patterns for the six A2/A3/A4 permutations (post-setup attempts len 1): 234->[ok,ok,ok]; 243->[ok,attempt-gap,ok]; 324,423... i.e. gap patterns distinguish orders; attempt-gap is reachable and order-discriminating.

duplicate-attempt is unreachable in all supplied single-fire profiles (each action fires once; duplicate needs exact pair re-occurrence, s_inclusive.py:29). Only candidate real witness: atomic action carrying an already-registered attempt_number (atomic:prior-unresolved:3, s_domain.py:128) — unverifiable, fixture bodies absent.

paused is Q-core-owned (absent from journal DEFAULTS, s_domain.py:13-14); adapters read it via journal-overlaid view (a_domain.py:25-27). Only supplied profile where pause precedes an attempt is publication-source-race (s_domain.py:115), and there attempt:2 can never be a gap/duplicate — so paused∧(gap∨duplicate) is unreachable everywhere; those precedence edges have no reachable discriminating witness.

source-restart is a delegated Q call; adapters bump journal generation separately (a_inclusive.py:16; a_split.py:10-18; a_audit.py:20-30) and semantic.py:51-53 requires paired advance. Q-side restart effect on paused is unverifiable (q reducer not in packet); order pause;R;A2 in s_domain.py:115 would discriminate it.

collect-open captures attempts+revision (s_inclusive.py:57); in fresh-incomplete orders (spec.json:23) captured-attempts deltas are masked at attest by the earlier incomplete-inventory check (s_inclusive.py:66-68), so visible refusals must be retained per-step, not only terminally.

summary: Inspection-only counterexample hunt over the attempt-order obligation. No reachable inter-implementation counterexample found: all six guard sites use identical precedence (no-registration > E-PAUSED > duplicate-attempt > attempt-gap) and identical pair construction. Two precedence edges are unreachable in every supplied profile; test proposal with reachable and synthetic discriminating controls was written to the allowed path.
